name: W Las Vegas
insider_take: This isn't your typical Vegas glitz – W Las Vegas brings New York-style sophistication to the Strip with a sleek, modern edge that attracts the fashion-forward crowd.
whats_special: W Las Vegas stands out as the only boutique luxury hotel directly on the Strip, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with unobstructed views of the Bellagio fountains. The hotel's Living Room lobby doubles as a social hub with a curated art collection, while the rooftop WET deck offers an adults-only pool experience with panoramic Strip views.
pro_tip: Book a Fountain View room on floors 20+ for the best vantage point of the Bellagio's iconic water shows – you'll have front-row seats without the crowds.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature EWOW suite (Extreme Wow) spans 2,300 square feet with a private terrace overlooking the Strip. For dining, Delilah offers an exclusive speakeasy experience with live jazz performances, while the hotel's direct connection to Crystals shopping center puts you steps away from high-end boutiques like Cartier and Tom Ford.
pros: Prime Strip location with stunning city and mountain views
Modern luxury design with signature W Hotels bold aesthetic
Vibrant rooftop pool and bar scene
High-tech amenities and contemporary guest rooms
cons: Higher price point typical of luxury Strip hotels
Party-focused atmosphere may not suit all travelers
